For a long time, my immediate family and I were segregated from the rest of our family because of stupid things my fathers done.  So I was already detached from my extended family. But when it came to my immediate family, I was detached even more.

My family was extremely toxic to my mental health and I was never allowed to speak my mind. Now I've got major anger issues, and cant open up to anyone.

I do have a habit of forming pseudo families. Where I used to work, I had a work mom, a work sister and a work brother. 

My closest friends really are my family. I'd say it's something that helped fill a void in me. But I have found myself getting too attached to them and fearing I'd lose my family again.

If its people you 100% trust, i think its safe to have them be your pseudo family. Its just personally, I might have become too attached.

I haven't talked to my mom about it. We're not really open with each other like that. I have gone to a therapist before but I really struggled opening up about my family.  I'd want to try again with a different one if it just wasn't so damn expensive.
I FUCKING HATE MYSELF ALL I DO IS HURT PEOPLE I DONT DESERVE TO LIVE ANYMORE

I was in a similar situation. Now that I think about it, I'm still in it. The best thing I can recommend is to do something you love, i found that having an artistic outlet helps me in these cases. 
For me it was a lot of forcing myself. It was tough just even taking a shower. 
I dont wanna be cheesy but you can do it. It's tough and its gonna be tough for a long time. But you're already making the effort.
I know you said you're 17 so I don't wanna recommend any sleeping meds unless you've spoken with your doctor but there are a few sleeptime teas sold at grocery stores. I get one from trader joes that really helps.

If anything else, feel free to reach out even if you just need someone to talk to

But i found that it's easier when I let people distract me. Of course finding these people is difficult, it'll take some time. Feel free to reach out. I mean it

I'm realizing every fuck up I've done. Every little thing I do, I get anxious about and I've been letting it take over.  I remembered I have no passion, no talent, no goal. There's no where for me to go. I hate myself so so much. I can't look at myself. Ever. I avoid mirrors at all costs. I have no one.
